_comment: API keys for Transitous GTFS-RT feeds that require authentication.
_comment2: Format: 'region/source-name': 'your-api-key'. Only realtime feeds need keys; static schedules work without.
_comment3: Feeds marked 'skip' in the Transitous catalog are automatically unskipped when a key is provided.
_goswift.ly (Swiftly): One key covers ~30 US agencies. Register at https://goswift.ly/realtime-api-key
_exo.quebec: One token covers 12 Quebec agencies. Register at https://exo.quebec/en/about/open-data/RequestAccessForm
_soundtransit.org: One key covers 4 WA agencies. Register at https://www.soundtransit.org/help-contacts/business-information/open-transit-data-otd
_individual_keys: Each of these requires a separate registration
